pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic values? (1 mark)
   A. Use Islamic values to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Islamic values has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic values.
   D. Apply the teaching of Islamic values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Inheritance? (1 mark)
   A. Say Inheritance has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Inheritance to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Inheritance.
   D. Apply the teaching of Inheritance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Science of Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Say Science of Hadith has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Science of Hadith.
   C. Apply the teaching of Science of Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Science of Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Science of Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Use Science of Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Science of Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Science of Qur’an.
   D. Apply the teaching of Science of Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic Finance? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Islamic Finance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Islamic Finance has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Islamic Finance to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic Finance.

6. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

8. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith.
   B. Use Selected Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.

9. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

10. Which response best shows understanding of Principles of handling disagreements in Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Use Principles of handling disagreements in Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Principles of handling disagreements in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Principles of handling disagreements in Islam.
   D. Say Principles of handling disagreements in Islam has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Care for the elderly? (1 mark)
   A. Say Care for the elderly has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Care for the elderly with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Care for the elderly to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Care for the elderly.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Selected chapter Surah Yusuf? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected chapter Surah Yusuf has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected chapter Surah Yusuf.
   C. Use Selected chapter Surah Yusuf to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected chapter Surah Yusuf with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic Finance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Principles of handling disagreements in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Care for the elderly and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic values and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Apply the teaching of Islamic values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. D — Apply the teaching of Inheritance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. C — Apply the teaching of Science of Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. D — Apply the teaching of Science of Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. A — Apply the teaching of Islamic Finance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. B — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

7. D — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

8. C — Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A — Telling the truth and keeping trust

10. B — Apply the teaching of Principles of handling disagreements in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. B — Apply the teaching of Care for the elderly with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. D — Apply the teaching of Selected chapter Surah Yusuf with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Islamic Finance; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Principles of handling disagreements in Islam; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Care for the elderly; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Islamic values; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
